hints.title: Parity Property
hints.text: The parity of set bits in x bitwise xor y bitwise xor z equals (parity(x) + parity(y) + parity(z)) % 2.

hints.title: Array Parity Counts
hints.text: Count how many elements have an even number of set bits and how many have an odd number in each of the three arrays.

hints.title: Combinatorial Cases
hints.text: Total sum is even if all three parities are even (0 odds), or exactly one is even and two are odd (2 odds).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan counting set bit parities.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(na * nb * nc) triple nested loop is redundant given algebraic parity independence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bit count parity homomorphism and count combinations in linear time.
